svg.title: Publish for the Buyer's Decision
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-buyer-intent-publication-gates; chapter number: 5; title: Publish for the Buyer's Decision; subtitle: Require genuine product fit, matching search intent, the right next action, and checked facts.; caption: Alex COLLINSEO, ToolTester Pro, Affiliate Marketing How To, and The SEO Desk supply the publication checks.; assumptions note: These gates combine Alex COLLINSEO's fit test, ToolTester Pro's search inspection, Affiliate Marketing How To's intent-specific actions, and The SEO Desk's fact checks. Passing them does not guarantee rankings or sales.; note: The Grow and Convert Marketing Show defines its reported alternative-content conversions as product-related actions such as trial starts or demo requests, not newsletter signups.; chart type: decision_tree; nodes: gate: G1; question: Does the proposed alternative genuinely fit the searcher's request?; pass next: G2; fail action: Pass on the stretched comparison, as Alex COLLINSEO recommends, rather than assuming ranking creates sales.; gate: G2; question: Do the live search results support the intended answer format and buyer decision?; pass next: G3; fail action: Follow ToolTester Pro by inspecting the winning page's first screen, structure, and answer format, then searching the same term.; gate: G3; question: Does the next action match this intent group?; pass next: G4; fail action: Follow Affiliate Marketing How To by separating affiliate-program invitations from pricing and trial offers.; gate: G4; question: Have changing prices, features, and other vulnerable facts actually been checked?; pass next: Publish with a real last-check date; fail action: Follow The SEO Desk by keeping a short list of vulnerable facts and verifying them before assigning a last-check date.

circle.title: gate: G1; question: Does the proposed alternative genuinely fit the searcher's request?; pass next: G2; fail action: Pass on the stretched comparison, as Alex COLLINSEO recommends, rather than assuming ranking creates sales.

gate: G2; question: Do the live search results support the intended answer format and buyer decision?; pass next: G3; fail action: Follow ToolTester Pro by inspecting the winning page's first screen, structure, and answer format, then searching the same term.

gate: G3; question: Does the next action match this intent group?; pass next: G4; fail action: Follow Affiliate Marketing How To by separating affiliate-program invitations from pricing and trial offers.

gate: G4; question: Have changing prices, features, and other vulnerable facts actually been checked?; pass next: Publish with a real last-check date; fail action: Follow The SEO Desk by keeping a short list of vulnerable facts and verifying them before assigning a last-check date.

text.title: Assumptions: These gates combine Alex COLLINSEO's fit test, ToolTester Pro's search inspection, Affiliate Marketing How To's intent-specific actions, and The SEO Desk's fact checks. Passing them does not guarantee rankings or sales.
text.tspan: Assumptions: These gates combine Alex COLLINSEO's fit test, ToolTester Pro's search inspection, Affiliate Marketing How To's intent-
